texto: PROJECT GENESIS is a work of fiction for adults. It deals with themes that some people may find disturbing or sensitive.

temas.detalle: Alcohol with its consequences; drugs, only played for humor.
Innuendo and sexualization of characters, with no explicit content.
Loneliness, existential tragedy and psychological horror.
Fights and deaths of fictional characters.

nota_efectos: The interface simulates glitches, flickering and image distortion. You can reduce them in Options.
ficcion: All characters and events in this work are fictional.
